target_use: research-only reconstruction of 2025 pregame player status/depth state

observed_archive_boundary.storage_mechanism: daily replacement of nfl/sleeper_data_latest.json preserved through Git commit history

regular_season_continuity.rule: Every 2025 regular-season game must have at least one archive snapshot no later than its T-120 cutoff and no more than 36 hours before that cutoff, unless explicitly marked missing.
regular_season_continuity.pass_threshold: at least 99% of games satisfy the window; all misses enumerated

snapshot_timestamp_integrity.rule: Use Git commit/author timestamp as archive-observation time; never infer a source-effective time later than the commit. Commit timestamp must be parseable for every used snapshot.

field_schema_stability.rule: Report field existence and non-null rates by snapshot/month/position; any midseason schema disappearance is a blocker until explained.
field_schema_stability.pass_threshold: player_id/team/status present where applicable; injury/practice missingness reported, never silently imputed

stable_identity.rule: Crosswalk Sleeper player_id to GSIS using nflverse roster/player crosswalks or DynastyProcess IDs; unresolved and duplicate mappings remain missing.
stable_identity.pass_threshold: at least 99.5% of status-bearing NFL players used in evaluation map unambiguously

official_report_concordance.rule: For a stratified manual sample across at least six 2025 weeks and 12 teams, compare archived injury_status/practice_participation with contemporaneous NFL official injury-report evidence available before kickoff.
official_report_concordance.pass_threshold: No evidence of systematic hindsight/final-status substitution; all disagreements categorized

revision_semantics.rule: Demonstrate at least several player-week status transitions across consecutive daily commits. A snapshot must reflect the state visible on that archive date rather than a later retrospectively rewritten value.

coverage_bias.rule: Report snapshot/status availability by team, position and week. Missingness cannot mean healthy or active.
coverage_bias.pass_threshold: no unexplained team/position coverage hole that would systematically bias the validation set

rights_and_cost.rule: Use remains $0 and non-commercial. Sleeper documents its API as free for non-commercial use; repository code is GPL-3.0, but archived API-output reuse must still be treated as requiring a specific data/terms review before redistribution.
rights_and_cost.pass_threshold: research storage/analysis judged permissible; no raw archive republishing by LevLine

if_passes.next_step: pre-register a narrow 2025-only availability/status predictive audit; passing this source audit does not itself authorize model fitting on 2022-2024 with a different source family or production promotion
allowed_features_for_next_prereg: days since injury start when trustworthy
prohibited_features: final inactive list learned after T-120

if_fails: continue prospective LevLine-owned snapshots for future seasons
